author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven
append_only: Superseded only by a later dated declaration. This file is never edited in place.

purpose.statement: One new Hospital trajectory, collected through the production collector, used only to prove that the collection pipeline executes and that the resulting on-disk trajectory is consumable by the three official data paths.

e2_status.e2_exclusion_reason: compatibility trajectory collected outside the preregistered E2 population
e2_status.excluded_by: construction -- the manifest carries e2_eligible=false and the E2 admission function refuses it
e2_status.not_excluded_by: wording, convention, reviewer memory, or a note in a document

the_bo10_trajectory_must_not_be_used_for: thesis effect-size claims based on E2

e2_deferred_decisions_untouched.statement: This declaration makes none of the four deferred E2 statistical-design decisions and changes no E2 expectation.
e2_deferred_decisions_untouched.authority: PREREGISTRATION.md Amendment 1; gates/g2_decisions.json remains the machine record of their status

g2_acknowledgement_authorisation.binding_requirement: the flag is honoured only when bound to this declaration by path and by SHA-256 digest
g2_acknowledgement_authorisation.is_not: a general bypass of the G2 block
g2_acknowledgement_authorisation.consequence_of_use: the collection manifest records purpose=BO10_FRAMEWORK_COMPATIBILITY and e2_eligible=false; that trajectory can never be admitted to the E2 population
g2_acknowledgement_authorisation.why_the_binding_exists: an acknowledgement flag that can be passed on its own is a bypass with a comment attached. Requiring the declaration digest means the only way to use the flag is to name the scope it was granted under, and the scope carries the exclusion.

machine_readable_manifest_fields.e2_exclusion_reason: compatibility trajectory collected outside the preregistered E2 population

enforcement.undeclared_is_refused: a manifest carrying no scope block is REFUSED, not admitted. Absence of a declaration must never read as eligibility -- that is the FL-019 shape, where a missing fact is consumed as a benign value.
enforcement.mandatory_negative_control: BO-10 trajectory -> E2 population inclusion attempt -> FAIL / REJECT

relationship_to_other_contracts.collection_route_admission_v1: unchanged; G1-G12 admission still governs whether any route may be collected
relationship_to_other_contracts.scene_wide_traversability: unchanged; Hospital remains NOT ADMISSIBLE scene-wide

non_claims: This declaration does not admit any route.
This declaration does not authorise the production Hospital collection.
This declaration makes no physical-hardware claim.
This declaration does not open E2, and does not weaken the G2 block for any other purpose.
